source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 1 January 1926, p. 5 ("Larne Re-elections")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Nominations were lodged only for Magill, Morrow and Ross; the paper states the other two retiring councillors 'will be deemed to be re-elected'.

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, January 1926; no contest in any ward (Belfast News-Letter, 1 January 1926, p. 5). Returned unopposed.
